questions.q_en: A man travels at the speed of 12 km/h on foot and 36 km/hr on bike. If he covered 240 km distance in 12 hours, then find the time taken by him on bike.
questions.solution_en:
Let the time taken on the bike be 't' hours.

According to question,

36 * t + (12 - t) * 12 = 240

=> 36t + 144 - 12t = 240

=> 24t = 96

=> t = 4

Hence, the required time is 4 hours.

questions.q_en: Two persons are 342 km apart, where one is at point A and the other is at point B. They start travelling in the same direction with speeds of 82 km/hr and 64 km/hr respectively. When the two persons cross each other, the estimated time will be:

Time = Distance/ Speed

= 342/ (82 - 64) [Moving in same directions, subtract the speed]

= 342/18 hours

= 19 hours

questions.q_en: A motor car does a journey in 39 hrs, the first half at 30 km/hr and the second half at 35 km/hr. Find the distance.
questions.solution_en:
Let the distance = X km

Then X/2 km is travelled at a speed of 30 km/hr and X/2 km at a speed of 35 km/hr.

Then time taken to travel the whole journey = [X/(2*30)] + [X/(2*35)] = 39 hrs

(X/60) + (X/70) = 39

13X/420 = 39

X = 39*420/13 = 1260 Km

questions.q_en: Distance between two points A and B is 54 km. Arun starts from A at 6 a.m. and travels towards B at 6 km/hr while Brij starts from B at 8 a.m. and travels towards A at 8 km/hr. At what time they will meet?

Distance covered by Arun in 2 hour = 6 * 2 = 12 km

Remaining distance = 54 - 12 = 42 km

Relative speed = 6 + 8 = 14 km/hr

Required time = 42/14 = 3 hours

They will meet at ( 8 + 3) = 11 a.m.

questions.q_en: Mohana and Rohan start travelling by their bikes simultaneously from place O to place P at the speed of 24 km/h and 36 km/hr, respectively. Rohan and Mohan reach the place P in T hours and (T + 1.6) hours, respectively. What is the distance between the place O and place P?
questions.solution_en:
The time taken by Rohan to reach place P is T hours.

And the time taken by Mohan to reach place P is (T + 1.6) hours.

According to the question

=> 24(T + 1.6) = 36 * T

=> 24T + 38.4 = 36T

=> 12T = 38.4

=> T = 3.2 hours

Now, distance between place O and place P = 24 * (3.2 + 1.6) = 115.2 km

questions.q_en: Dheeraj covers 2/3th of distance at the rate of 5km/hr and the rest of the distance at 8km/hr, and manages to cover the overall distance in 7 hours. Find the total distance covered by Dheeraj?
questions.solution_en:
Let the total distance be D km.

Distance covered at the rate of 5km/hr = 2/3 D

Distance covered at the rate of 8km/hr = 1/3 D

We know, Time =distance/Speed

Let us equate the time taken to cover partial distances to the time taken to cover overall distance.

7= ((2/3)D)/5+ ((1/3)D)/8 Or 2D/15 + D/24 = 7

21D/120 = 7 or D = 7 x 120/21 = 40 km

questions.q_en: A bus started running at 12:08 pm in the afternoon at a speed of 160 km/h and it halts for 10 minutes after travelling every 12 km, then at what time it will be 480 km away from starting point?
questions.solution_en:
Halting time = Number of halts * Time taken for each halting = (40 - 1) * 10 = 390 minutes = 6.5 hours

Total time to cover 480 km = 480/160 + 6.5 = 9.5 hours

So, the time at which the bus will be 480 km away from the starting point = 12:08 pm + 9 hours 30 minutes = 9:38 pm

questions.q_en: A boy rides his bicycle with speed 36 km/hr from point A to point B. A girl is riding her bicycle with speed 24 km/hr from point B to point A. If they meet after 2 hrs and the girl takes another 3 hrs to reach point A, then after how much time does the boy reach point B (in hrs)?
questions.solution_en:
Let the distance between A and B be 'd' km and the distance at which they meet be 'n' km from A.

Time taken by boy till they meet = time taken by girl till they meet

So, n = 36 * 2 = 72 km

And (d - n) = 24 * 2 = 48 km

Hence, time taken by boy to cover the remaining distance, i.e., 48 km = 48/36 = 1(1/3) hrs

questions.q_en: A thief is noticed by a policeman from a distance of 250/3 m. The thief starts running and the policeman chases him. The thief and the policeman run at the rate of 19 km and 20 km per hour respectively. What is the distance between them after 2 minutes?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed = 20 - 19 = 1 kmph

Distance covered in 2 minutes = (2/60) x 1 = 1/30 km = 100/3 m

Required distance between police and thief = (250/3) - (100/3) = 150/3 = 50 m

questions.q_en: A thief running at 7.5 kmph is chased by a policeman whose speed is 9.5 kmph. If the thief is 120 m ahead of the policeman, the time required for the policeman to catch the thief will be:
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed = 9.5 - 7.5 = 2 kmph = 2 * 5/18 = 5/9 m/sec

Distance = 120 m

Required time for the policeman to catch the thief = 120/(5/9) = 216 sec = 3 min 36 sec
